records.title: Construction of New De-Addition Centres in Andhra Pradesh
details: b to c: DoSJE has identified 291 gap districts, including 7 districts of Andhra Pradesh for setting up of District De-addition centres (DDAC) to address the concern of substance abuse across the country. Advertisement has already been issued for setting up of DDAC in the gap districts.
